name: report-check
description: A note under a medium-effort agent's report, before the main loop reads it: check its negative claims ("none", "not found", "not used") with a command of your own. Other levels, empty and consumed reports pass as they were. English or Russian. A Claude Code mod for 2.1.329 and later (agent.report); companion to pace-band, which keeps working on older Claude Code.

language.title: Language
language.description: Of the note. auto follows pace-band's language when it is installed, else Claude Code's own Language setting (/config); en or ru pins one.
